published_ranges._enclosure: Vendor text: 'High heat resistance- with no need for heated chamber!' (see conflicts)
published_ranges._notes: Values from reseller copies of the Push Plastic product description (official page returned 429). Colours from HartSmart listing of the 3kg SKU. Drying temperature/time not published by vendor. Generic PA used because nylon grade not stated. Earlier entry: Absorbs moisture rapidly - dry before printing. Slower speeds and extra bed adhesive for large parts. No unfilled-Nylon TDS cited, so density and HDT are not given.
